concepts.name: Market Structure Shift (MSS)
detection_rules: Timeframe: 1m only
Swing wing: 2 bars each side (5-bar pivot)
Scan: last 12 bars of 80-bar lookback, most recent MSS wins
Bullish MSS: candle body close > prior swing high (index before break bar)
Bearish MSS: candle body close < prior swing low
Wick-only pierce does NOT qualify — close required

states.bullish: bullish MSS detected OR tradeable_bias fallback when no MSS
states.bearish: bearish MSS detected OR tradeable_bias fallback
states.unclear: no MSS and tradeable_bias not bullish/bearish
states.pending: NOT IMPLEMENTED — no pending MSS state in engine
states.confirmed: MSS present on last qualifying close (same as detected)
states.invalidated: price closed back through MSS level (observation-facts only)

accept_criteria: Body close beyond most recent qualifying swing high/low
Swing exists before break bar (index < barIndex - 1)
reject_criteria: Wick through swing without body close
gaps: mapStructure falls back to tradeable_bias when MSS null — may mask absent MSS
Not distinguished from CHoCH in code (comment says not CHoCH but same logic)

concepts.name: Relative Equal High (REH)
detection_rules: Two implementations: observation-engine uses clustering (reh-rel.ts); structureFacts uses paired 3-bar swings (structure.ts)
Observation path: 3-bar swing highs (wing=1), cluster via union-find when pairwise diff ≤ tolerance
REH level = max(high) in cluster; requires ≥2 swings
Active REH: level ≥ currentPrice + 0.25 (REH_REL_PRICE_EPS)
Swept: last candle close > REH level (candle_close policy)

states.unknown: reh_rel.status unknown — <5 candles or bad price

accept_criteria: Pool level strictly above current price (+ eps)
reject_criteria: Swings differ by more than tolerance
gaps: structure.ts paired-swing REH differs from reh-rel.ts clustering — two algorithms
structureFacts.relativeEqualPools not wired into observation reh_rel block

concepts.name: Relative Equal Low (REL)
detection_rules: Mirror of REH on swing lows
REL level = min(low) in cluster
Active REL: level ≤ currentPrice - 0.25
Swept: last candle close < REL level

concepts.name: Liquidity sweep
detection_rules: Levels: PDH, PDL, PDC (+ session highs/lows listed but not sweep-scanned by default)
Sell-side sweep (below level): bar.low ≤ level AND bar.close < level
Buy-side sweep (above level): bar.high ≥ level AND bar.close > level
Lookback: 40 bars, most recent per level
Observation liquidity_swept = any level.taken === true

required_data.body_vs_wick: wick pierce + close confirmation through/beyond level

gaps: Session highs/lows in observation levels always taken=false unless in liquiditySweeps
REH/REL sweeps tracked separately in reh_rel block

concepts.name: Fair Value Gap (FVG)
detection_rules: 3-candle pattern on 1m
Bullish: c1.high < c3.low AND gap ≥ 3 pts
Bearish: c1.low > c3.high AND gap ≥ 3 pts
Unfilled: <50% overlap fill OR no full traverse (isGapFilled)
Inverted: body closed through gap → IFVG (m1InvertedFvgs)
Observation reports most recent unfilled FVG; if only inverted → status invalidated
gaps: SPEC_NOT_BUILT: fvg_validity tradeability (valid vs present_not_tradeable) — labeled in fixtures but NOT in observation engine
first_presented_fvg tracked in facts but not in observation.fvg field
Volume imbalance flag exists in types but not enforced in detection

concepts.name: Order block relevance
detection_rules: Heuristic only — no OB zone geometry
relevant if MSS present (with or without FVG)
unclear if FVG without MSS
irrelevant otherwise
gaps: SPEC_NOT_BUILT: no actual order block detection — placeholder heuristic

concepts.name: Displacement
detection_rules: Last 12 candles, check last 5 for impulsive body
Body = |close - open|
Present if any body > avgBody × 1.5 (avg excludes last 3 candles)
Reports displacement_points as body size in points
gaps: Direction not captured in observation (narrative assumes upward)
